_about: The measured inputs of fig:breakeven (ev_breakeven.py): Llama-2-7B's shapes with random int8 weights, the prover on an NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti, the CPU client (verifier and re-execution) on 8 threads of an Intel Xeon Silver 4114, the paper's configuration (Fiat-Shamir where marked fs, the compact encoding, the lean prover, the last block pruned, Kpre with the verifier's own embedding rows). Mode C's fixed part (u, opened columns, paths) is not an input: ev_breakeven.py computes it from the byte model. Each value names the script and the record field it was read from.

weights_int8_GB.source: the int8 weights of Llama-2-7B's shapes (pvi.models.decoder.CONFIGS), one byte per weight: one download

v1_ratio_2048.source: v1/v1_bytes.py --model llama2-7b --seq 2048 --modes Kpre on 2 and 3 blocks: v0's claims over V1's, 2.28 and 2.32

64.source: costs/perf.py --model llama2-7b --seq 64 --modes Kpre --verifier-device cpu, interactive (int) and Fiat-Shamir (fs): verify_s of the native CPU verifier

2048.source: costs/perf.py --model llama2-7b --seq 2048 --modes Kpre --verifier-device cpu, interactive (int) and Fiat-Shamir (fs): verify_s of the native CPU verifier

v1_verifier_s_2048.source: v1/v1_phases.py: V1's CPU verifier in Kpre under Fiat-Shamir with the native kernels of its final check, 2.28 s for 2 blocks plus 30 x 1.44 s for the other blocks of the full model

64.source: reexec/reexec.py --model llama2-7b --seq 64 --device cpu --threads 8: the full model's time of exact re-execution (the integer forward pass, its faster GEMM path: exact fp32 GEMMs), of fp32 and of the inexact dynamic int8 engine

2048.source: reexec/reexec.py --model llama2-7b --seq 2048 --device cpu --threads 8: the full model's time of exact re-execution (the integer forward pass), of fp32 and of the inexact dynamic int8 engine
